# KoiCard

> AI-powered business card scanner that turns a photo of a business card into an organized, searchable contact, instantly. Built for anyone who networks in person: conference attendees, founders, sales and BD teams, recruiters, and students.

KoiCard lets you take a photo (or scan a QR code / vCard) of a business card and get name, title, company, email, phone, website, and LinkedIn (when printed) extracted automatically by AI. Contacts sync across devices, can be tagged with follow-up dates and urgency, color-coded, exported to CSV, or synced to Google Sheets. Accounts are free to create; heavier use during multi-day events is covered by a paid Event Pass or monthly plan.

## Product
- [KoiCard homepage](https://koicard.app/landing): Product overview, feature list, and pricing
- [Privacy Policy](https://koicard.app/privacy): What data is collected and how it's used
- [Terms & Conditions](https://koicard.app/terms): Terms of service

## Pricing
- Free: 10 scans per month, no credit card required
- Event Pass: $5.99, up to 300 scans over 4 days (aimed at multi-day conferences)
- Monthly: $7.99/month, up to 500 scans per month
- Mini Pass: $3.99, 150 extra scans valid for 30 days, for anyone who runs out (free or paid users)

## Key features
- Camera or photo-upload business card scanning with AI-based field extraction
- QR code and vCard/MECARD parsing for cards that already carry digital contact data
- Reads LinkedIn links printed on the card
- Reads QR codes: contact QR codes (vCard/MECARD) fill the whole contact instantly without using a scan; website or LinkedIn QR codes add the link
- Manual and follow-up-date-based urgency flags, with reminders
- Color-coded contact organization and search
- CSV export and optional Google Sheets sync via webhook
- Gifting: buy an Event Pass for $5.99 and send the private claim link to anyone; it works once
- Cross-device sync via account sign-in (Google OAuth)

## Company
KoiCard is built by Yorkseed Venture Studio, a student entrepreneurship community.
